name: csharp-toolkit
description: A C#/.NET toolkit for Pulsar: create whole .NET projects and scaffold classes, interfaces, controllers, Razor pages, UWP views, test classes and constructors — right from the tree view. Formerly published as csharpextensions-pulsar.

namespaceStyle.title: Namespace style
namespaceStyle.description: Block scoped (`namespace X { ... }`) or file-scoped (`namespace X;` — C# 10+).

enableNullable.title: Nullable reference types
enableNullable.description: Adds `#nullable enable` at the top of every generated C# file.

interfacePrefix.title: Interface prefix
interfacePrefix.description: Prefix automatically prepended to new interface names. Set to an empty string to disable.

enum.description: Allman — opening brace on its own line
K&R — opening brace on the same line

constructorStyle.title: Default constructor style
constructorStyle.description: Style used by `Constructor from Properties` (the separate `...expression-body` command always uses expression-bodied).

testFramework.title: Unit test framework
testFramework.description: Framework used by the generic `New Unit Test Class` command.

confirmUsingDirectives.title: Confirm adding using directives
confirmUsingDirectives.description: Ask before adding missing `using` directives when generating a constructor. When unchecked they are added silently.

hideAspNetGroupWhenNotNeeded.title: Hide ASP.NET group in non-ASP.NET projects
hideAspNetGroupWhenNotNeeded.description: Detects Microsoft.AspNetCore.* in the nearest .csproj and hides the Controller / Api Controller / Razor Page group when the project is not ASP.NET Core. Unknown projects (no .csproj) keep the group.

hideUwpGroupWhenNotNeeded.title: Hide UWP group in non-UWP projects
hideUwpGroupWhenNotNeeded.description: Detects UWP/WinUI markers (UniversalWindowsPlatform, WindowsAppSDK, WinUI, UAP target, UseWinUI) in the nearest .csproj and hides the UWP group when the project is not UWP/WinUI.

openCreatedProjectIn.title: Open created .NET project
openCreatedProjectIn.description: Where to open a freshly scaffolded .NET project after `dotnet new` finishes.
